behaviours.meaning: the protective stop of the position (where it rests, how it fills, how it is booked) decides the outcome
a candle OPENS through a resting level (stop, target, safety order): the fill is at the gapped open, never the level
the full take-profit target (slot.target) closes the position
the holding-time limit (slot.time_exit.bars, candles counted from the entry candle) closes the position
the trading day is the Africa/Cairo calendar day (DST-aware) of the decision candle CLOSE, not its open
the daily-loss halt: a realised loss beyond the daily limit blocks new entries for the rest of that trading day
DCA safety orders add to the position at preset adverse levels and the whole basket closes at its target
the taker fee and slippage of every market fill (entry, add, exit) are what the expected R / pnl assert
pyramid adds grow the position in the trade direction at preset favourable levels
a trailing / ratcheting protective level recomputed at candle closes (slot.trail)
a trailing ENTRY (entry.type trail): armed at the signal, it fills only after the set rebound / drop
the slot's max_pos limit on positions open or armed at the same time
the SHORT mirror of a path: a sell entry with every price, slippage and comparison inverted
the machine exit code itself (EXIT_CODE_MEANING) is the asserted distinction, beyond the fill price
part of the position is closed before the final exit
the first partial take-profit level (slot.tp1)
the exchange filters (instruments: step, min_qty, min_notional) decide whether an order can be sent at all
exchange_outage fault: the bot can neither read nor send while orders resting on the exchange still work
restart fault: the bot process stops and comes back from its persisted state, keeping the position clock
lost_response fault: an order reached the exchange but its answer was lost; the bot resolves it from the order record (no phantom, no duplicate)
the entry order itself (sending, filling and booking it) is the asserted path
